title: 10.2 Finding Arc Measures

icans: I can find the measures of minor arcs, major arcs, and semicircles.
I can use the Arc Addition Postulate to find arc measures.
I can tell whether two arcs are congruent.

vocab: an angle whose __________ is the center of the circle
an arc whose __________ is less than 180°
an arc whose __________ is greater than 180°
an arc whose ____________ are the endpoints of a diameter
arcs that have the same __________ and are in the same circle or congruent circles

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Arc measures: a minor arc has the same measure as its _______________ angle. A major arc measures _______________ minus its minor arc. A semicircle measures 180°.
Naming arcs: a minor arc uses its two endpoints; a major arc or a semicircle uses _______________ letters.

blocks.stem:
Find the measure of each arc of circle P.
a.  arc AB
b.  arc ACB

notes: Arc Addition Postulate: the measure of an arc formed by two adjacent arcs is the _______________ of the measures of the two arcs.

blocks.stem:
Find the measure of each arc of circle O.
a.  arc ABC
b.  arc ADC

notes: Congruent Central Angles Theorem: in the same circle or congruent circles, two minor arcs are congruent if and only if their central angles are _______________.

blocks.stem: A̅C̅ is a diameter of circle O. Find the value of x. Then find m(arc AB).
Three arcs make up a whole circle. They measure (3x)°, (5x + 8)°, and (2x + 12)°. Find x and the measure of each arc.

tickets.stem: A central angle measures 48°. What is the measure of the major arc with the same endpoints?
Arcs AB and BC are adjacent. m(arc AB) = 75° and m(arc BC) = 38°. Find m(arc ABC).
